Brother Smith

Overview

The Brother Smith serves the Last Shelter. He initially refuses Kir because a stranger has no place in the brotherhood’s exchange of services. Once Kir is accepted, the smith welcomes him and offers his craft for payment. [1, 2]

The ring and the brotherhood

Khatul demands an imperial signet ring from a cyclops as a test of trust. Kir brings it back and explains his intention to free his family. He also recognises that the ring does not match the description he has read. Khatul already knows it is false, but asks him to preserve the brotherhood’s belief in the trophy. Membership changes how Brother Smith receives Kir: the smith who refused a stranger now offers his craft. Through Aliya, Kir also searches for the missing Sahilia, rescues her and brings medicine. Sahilia’s recovery matters later, when her forged papers open a route into the army. [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]
